title: Payload-Only Controller Actions
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, and choose an input-head direction, an optional emitted bit, a payload-head direction, and an optional loop-host successor state. The controller action with no flag or counter operation and with the payload head moving by the chosen direction equals the right-block extension of the one-tape action that makes no write, moves its head by that direction, emits the chosen bit, and has the chosen successor state.
replaced:
For every head direction $d$, optional emitted bit, and successor state, the loop-
controller action that only moves the payload head by $d$ and emits that bit equals the
right-block extension (leaving all earlier tapes stationary) of the corresponding one-
tape action.
